# UNESCO
> UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, promoting peace through international cooperation in education, science, culture, communication and information.

UNESCO works with Member States and partners to advance knowledge, protect heritage, strengthen education systems, support scientific cooperation, and foster freedom of expression and access to information worldwide.

## About UNESCO
- [UNESCO Homepage](https://www.unesco.org/en): Main entry point to UNESCO’s mission, priorities, programmes and institutional information.
- [UNESCO in Brief](https://www.unesco.org/en/brief): Overview of UNESCO’s mandate, structure, priorities and global role.
- [Our History](https://www.unesco.org/en/brief/history): Historical background on UNESCO’s founding, evolution and major milestones.
- [Key Data](https://www.unesco.org/en/key-data): Facts, figures and indicators about UNESCO’s work and global reach.
- [Laboratory of Ideas](https://www.unesco.org/en/laboratory-ideas): Explains UNESCO’s role as a forum for ideas, standards and policy dialogue.
- [Visit Us](https://www.unesco.org/en/visit-us): Visitor information for UNESCO headquarters and public access details.

## Governance and Member States
- [Governance](https://www.unesco.org/en/governance): Central hub for UNESCO’s governing structure, bodies and institutional processes.
- [General Conference](https://www.unesco.org/en/general-conference): Information on UNESCO’s supreme governing body, sessions and decisions.
- [Executive Board](https://www.unesco.org/en/executive-board): Details on the Executive Board’s role, membership and meeting materials.
- [Member States Portal](https://www.unesco.org/en/member-states-portal): Resources and services for UNESCO Member States and permanent delegations.
- [Governing Bodies Events](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/governing-bodies): Calendar and listings for meetings of UNESCO’s governing bodies.
- [Statutory Meetings](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/statutory-meetings): Schedule and information for statutory meetings and formal sessions.

## News, Press and Stories
- [Newsroom](https://www.unesco.org/en/newsroom): Official newsroom for announcements, media materials and institutional updates.
- [News](https://www.unesco.org/en/search?f%5B0%5D=type%3Anews&sort_by=unesco_date&sort_order=DESC&text=): Search results page listing recent UNESCO news items.
- [Stories](https://www.unesco.org/en/stories): Feature stories highlighting UNESCO programmes, people and impact worldwide.
- [Press Releases](https://www.unesco.org/en/newsroom/press-release): Official press releases on UNESCO decisions, initiatives and statements.

## Events and Commemorations
- [Calendar of Events](https://www.unesco.org/en/events): Master calendar of UNESCO conferences, meetings, observances and public events.
- [Calendar](https://www.unesco.org/en/events): Main events listing for upcoming UNESCO activities and sessions.
- [Cultural Events at Headquarters](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/cultural): Exhibitions, performances and cultural programming hosted at UNESCO headquarters.
- [UNESCO Commemorations](https://www.unesco.org/en/commemorations): International days, anniversaries and commemorative observances recognized by UNESCO.

## Partnerships and Cooperation
- [Partnerships](https://www.unesco.org/en/partnerships): Overview of UNESCO’s collaboration with governments, NGOs, academia and the private sector.
- [Member States Portal](https://www.unesco.org/en/member-states-portal): Operational portal supporting cooperation with Member States and delegations.
- [Governance](https://www.unesco.org/en/governance): Institutional framework that supports intergovernmental cooperation and decision-making.

## Core Mission Areas
- [Education](https://www.unesco.org/en): UNESCO’s work to expand equitable, inclusive and quality education globally.
- [Science](https://www.unesco.org/en): UNESCO programmes supporting scientific cooperation, sustainability and knowledge sharing.
- [Culture](https://www.unesco.org/en): UNESCO initiatives to protect heritage and promote cultural diversity.
- [Communication and Information](https://www.unesco.org/en): Work on freedom of expression, media development and access to information.

## Institutional Resources
- [UNESCO in Brief](https://www.unesco.org/en/brief): Concise institutional summary useful for orientation and background research.
- [Key Data](https://www.unesco.org/en/key-data): Quantitative reference page for UNESCO’s programmes and organizational footprint.
- [Our History](https://www.unesco.org/en/brief/history): Reference material on UNESCO’s institutional development over time.
- [Visit Us](https://www.unesco.org/en/visit-us): Practical information for visiting UNESCO and attending public activities.
